response.justification: Bogdan brings well over the 8-year software development minimum and a genuinely strong developer-tooling profile: he authored a D test runner and assertion library, built and maintained GitLab/CI/deploy infrastructure, taught Selenium/TDD courses, and now works on MCP code generators and agentic developer tooling. Technical depth, testing focus, and system design breadth are clearly there, plus incidental mobile exposure (iOS/Apple TV apps, mobile device orchestration). However, the resume shows no people-management history — no direct reports, no performance reviews, no hiring or org-change leadership — which is a core, explicitly required dimension of this Level II Manager role. Staff-level titles and mentoring/community work suggest leadership potential, but this reads as an IC track profile rather than a manager one. Worth a screening call if the team is open to a first-time manager with exceptional tooling expertise; otherwise a mismatch.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer-tools and test-infrastructure track record (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, GitLab)
14+ years across web, mobile, desktop and embedded, far exceeding the experience minimum
Strong mentoring/teaching signal: workshops, courses, conference talks, open-source community
concerns: No evidence of formal people management or direct reports (2-year minimum unmet)
No demonstrated roadmap ownership, org-change leadership, or cross-team alignment at scale
Mobile-platform ecosystem exposure is dated and peripheral, not build-system focused

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and testing infrastructure expertise
